Row.Text: A dark-skinned man with large spiraled horns and an orange headband looks sternly forward.

A dark-skinned man with a serious expression looks forward. He has two large, dark, spiraled horns extending from his head. An orange bandanna covers his forehead above a darker blue band, with white braided strands hanging by his ears. He wears a dark top, and a colorful striped garment in blue and yellow is visible over his right shoulder. The head-and-shoulders portrait is set against a plain purple background, showcasing dominant dark skin tones, vibrant orange, deep black horns, and touches of bright blue and yellow.
A stern-faced, white-bearded king in a golden crown and grey chainmail, looking left against a blue background.

The portrait shows a stern-faced, white-bearded man, depicted from the chest up. He wears a golden crown adorned with prominent red oval gems and cross-shaped finials. His head and neck are covered by a grey chainmail coif. He also wears golden plate armor with silver trim on his shoulders. The man has a fair complexion and a long, full white beard and mustache. His gaze is directed to the left, conveying a resolute expression. The background is a plain, solid light blue.
A heavily bearded man in a Viking helmet and fur cloak holds a dark spear against a clear blue sky.

A heavily built man with an intense gaze stares forward from under a silver helmet featuring a golden faceplate. His long, thick, brown-gold beard covers most of his lower face, blending into a shaggy, light brown fur cloak draped over his broad shoulders. A vibrant purple garment is visible beneath the fur on either side. He holds a dark, sharp, pointed blade, possibly a spearhead or axe, angled upwards on his left. The backdrop is a clear, bright light blue sky.
A muscular man with a stern expression wears a lion's head as a hood and its golden-brown pelt as a shaggy cloak.

A formidable man with a stern expression and short beard looks to the right. He wears the head of a lion as a hood, complete with fangs visible over his brow, and its golden-brown pelt as a shaggy cloak draped over his shoulders and upper body. His strong, tanned arms are visible, suggesting a powerful build. He wears a simple, muted green garment beneath the pelt. The figure is set against a simple, solid light blue background, emphasizing his prominent and resolute presence.
A woman with an elaborate spiky golden headdress and a yellow robe looks forward against a blue background.

A woman with East Asian features is depicted from the chest up against a plain light blue background. She wears a rich golden-yellow tunic or robe with a subtle pattern. Her dark hair is styled in an elaborate updo, crowned by a prominent golden headdress featuring a spiky, fan-like ornament above her forehead and a golden hairpin extending horizontally. Red tassel earrings hang from her ears. Around her neck is a necklace made of white, stylized tooth or claw-shaped pendants. She looks directly forward with red-painted lips.
A woman in a bronze Greek helmet with a prominent red crest looks left from a golden background.

A woman with brown hair and fair skin wears a bronze Corinthian-style helmet with a large, bright red horsehair crest. Her head is turned sharply to her left, with a subtle smirk on her face and a direct gaze. She is clad in a white cloak draped over her right shoulder, fastened by a gold circular clasp, with a hint of red fabric visible beneath. The portrait-style image is set against a solid golden-yellow background, emphasizing the bronze and red tones of her armor and plume.
Mirrored figures with feathered headpieces: one smirks, one frowns, set against a bright yellow background.

Two figures with dark skin are depicted in mirrored profiles, shown from the chest up against a vibrant yellow background. They both wear tall, conical headpieces with gold trim and a pattern of golden triangles. The left figure's headpiece is red, while the right's is orange. Behind these, large, vibrant blue and orange feathers form an elaborate headdress. The left figure looks back with a sly smirk, while the right figure looks forward with a stern expression. Both figures are bare-chested.
A broad-shouldered man with dark skin, feathered headwear, and a large curved pendant against a solid green background.

A portrait features a broad-shouldered man with dark brown skin and a muscular build, shown from the chest up. He has a strong jawline, a thick neck, and dark hair pulled back, with two brown and white feathers rising from the back of his head. He wears a light brown, possibly woven, collar-like adornment with a large, curved, off-white bone or shell pendant at his throat. A dark, shaggy fringe, possibly fur or feathers, crosses his right shoulder. His head is turned slightly, and he looks up and to the right with a confident expression. The background is a solid, vibrant lime green.
A young female warrior in a red tunic and blue helmet with a large red plume looks over her shoulder, holding a recurve bow.

The portrait features a young East Asian female warrior, shown from the chest up, looking back over her right shoulder with a determined expression. She wears a dark blue helmet adorned with a golden band and a central green gem, featuring a large red plume on its left side and dark brown leather ear flaps. Her attire consists of a vibrant red tunic or cape, secured by dark brown ties across her chest. A brown recurve bow is partially visible along her right side. The background is a solid, bright lime green.
A dark-skinned woman smiles, wearing an orange headwrap, red beaded necklace with a lightning bolt pendant, and a white tunic.

A dark-skinned woman is depicted from the chest up, smiling slightly and looking directly forward. She wears an orange headwrap over dark dreadlocks, with a single gold hoop earring visible. Around her neck is a long red beaded necklace, featuring a prominent gold lightning bolt pendant. She is dressed in a loose-fitting white tunic with wide, soft folds. The overall color palette is warm, with her rich skin tone, bright orange headwrap, and red beads contrasting with a solid, light blue background.
A dark-skinned man with a dark beard and mustache wears a purple turban and a brown vest against a red background.

A dark-skinned man is shown from the chest up, wearing a purple turban with gold patterns and a dark beard and mustache. He looks slightly to the viewer's left with an intense expression. He wears a white shirt under a brown sleeveless vest with an ornate gold and red patterned border at the bottom. A colorful beaded necklace with blue, red, and orange beads hangs around his neck, featuring a prominent gold coin pendant. The background is a solid, vibrant red.
A golden-furred, monkey-faced figure with a black headband and a staff against a purple background.

The portrait features a humanoid figure with bright golden fur covering its face and ears, and yellow hair styled into a high ponytail tied with a red band. It wears a dark blue or black headband adorned with golden swirling patterns across its forehead. Its yellowish eyes are narrow and look downward with a focused expression. The figure is clad in a dark grey garment and a black scarf wrapped around its neck and shoulder. A metallic staff, golden at the top and dark purple on the shaft, is partially visible on the right. The backdrop is a solid, vibrant purple.
